version.reason: The release before `blobhash` becomes a Solidity global and Yul built-in in 0.8.24; iterating targets shows solc has no notion of the name here while slang still rejects it.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc 0.8.23 accepts `let blobhash := 1` on every target it supports, since `blobhash` is neither a global nor a Yul built-in yet. slang rejects it as shadowing a Solidity global because its global lookup is not gated by version or target (the ungated `lookup_global` limitation). Below Constantinople and from Cancun on the two sides agree only because solc declines those targets outright at this version. Fixing the lookup gating will remove this divergence.
